name: geoai
description: PhysEarth-Agent's physical model registry, evidence rules and bundled corpus, as a workflow a coding agent follows.

interface.shortDescription: Run registered physical models and cite the evidence actually read
interface.longDescription: Brings the PhysEarth-Agent engine into a coding agent as procedure rather than as a pile of tools: which model answers which geophysical question, what a valid run looks like, which refusals are results to report rather than failures to retry, and the citation rules that keep every unit-bearing number traceable to a run or a section that was actually read. The tools themselves come from the physearth-geoai MCP server in the same repository.
defaultPrompt: Sweep snow density in SMRT and plot brightness temperature.
Reproduce figure 4 of the bundled SMRT paper and cite what you read.
Compare two registered models on one observable, in matching units.
